about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I’m Mohamed Lassoued, a Master’s student in Data Science at ISI Mahdia and a full-stack and mobile developer from Djerba, Tunisia. I build web and mobile applications as well as data-driven solutions, with a strong focus on user experience.
about.paragraph2: Since 2025, I’ve worked as a freelance web developer. I also completed my final-year internship at Wyze Academy in France, where I built Umrah Fly, a React Native app with an AI assistant. I’m also exploring Big Data with Hadoop, MapReduce and Apache Iceberg.
about.paragraph3: Alongside development, I run DjerbaLens, my travel photography brand, and work in visual communication and social media for tourism agencies in Djerba.

projects.title: Development Projects
projects.description: A selection of my recent work across web, mobile, AI and Big Data.

umrahFly.title: Umrah Fly
umrahFly.description: A mobile platform designed to streamline Umrah pilgrimage management for travelers and agencies. It integrates an AI assistant with RAG for instant, context-aware guidance, voice interaction through speech recognition, and two-layer content moderation. Built with React Native and a Node.js/Express backend, it uses PostgreSQL and vector embeddings for search, n8n automation, Docker containers and an Azure deployment.

amazonReviews.title: Amazon Reviews – Big Data Analysis
amazonReviews.description: Master’s project completed in a pair: distributed analysis of the Amazon Reviews 2023 dataset (Appliances) using three Java Hadoop MapReduce jobs and Apache Iceberg tables, in a Docker environment with HDFS, YARN and Spark.

scooterDjerba.title: Scooter Djerba – Rental Website
scooterDjerba.description: A freelance scooter rental website built for a Djerba agency. It supports online bookings and automatically emails the agency when a customer submits a request.

djerbaLens.title: DjerbaLens – Photography Platform
djerbaLens.description: A web platform for my travel photography brand focused on Djerba and Tunisia, with a dynamic gallery, client reviews, contact form and AI chatbot. An n8n workflow automates social publishing by generating captions with an LLM and posting them to Instagram.

ecommerce.title: E-Commerce Platform
ecommerce.description: A full-stack MERN application for a seamless online shopping experience, featuring authentication, product management and a dynamic cart. Its Tailwind CSS interface makes it easy to browse, search and manage products, while the backend secures data and API communication with Express and MongoDB.

jobify.title: Jobify – Smart Job Tracker
jobify.description: A modern application for managing job applications efficiently, with real-time updates, intuitive filters and a clear organization system to keep your job search on track.

heartDisease.title: Heart Disease Prediction
heartDisease.description: An AI-powered web app that estimates heart disease risk using a Random Forest model. Built with Next.js and Flask and deployed on Vercel and Render, it provides quick results based on user input.

djerbaGo.title: DjerbaGo – Smart Travel Recommender
djerbaGo.description: An interactive Streamlit app that helps visitors discover activities in Djerba based on preferences such as category, age, mood and duration. It features a dynamic map, CSV export, favorites and itinerary planning to improve the visitor experience.

todos.title: CopilotKit Todo App
todos.description: A React task-management app for adding, updating and deleting tasks. CopilotKit adds AI assistant capabilities to make organizing tasks easier.
